title: Missing ffmpeg binary still dies with a raw FileNotFoundError traceback — the r2 guard section covers every external failure except this one
detail: The r1 review flagged unguarded externals; r2 added SystemExit guards for missing SRC, sha mismatch, sampwidth, channels, window fit, and a hung ffmpeg (timeout) — but a machine without ffmpeg gets an uncaught FileNotFoundError at the first subprocess call, not an actionable note. No try/except or shutil.which exists in the file.
recommended_fix: Wrap the ffmpeg probes: `if shutil.which("ffmpeg") is None: raise SystemExit("ffmpeg not found — install ffmpeg with a vorbis encoder")` before line 113.

title: Audio-identity mismatch against the committed artifact is advisory-only: DIFFERS prints but the script exits 0 after already overwriting the committed OGG
detail: The r1 B1 fold makes the decoded-PCM comparison the across-toolchain identity check, but the mismatch branch only prints: the `-y` encode has already replaced assets/audio/ambience_loop.ogg and the process exits 0, so nothing automated (or an inattentive rerun) can fail on a non-reproducing toolchain.
recommended_fix: On DIFFERS, also `raise SystemExit(1)` (or restore the prior OGG bytes) so a non-identical re-encode surfaces as a failure instead of a stdout line.
